detail.title: Predictive Dissipation Dynamics: Integrating Renormalization and Information Entropy
detail.summary: This research iteration integrates renormalization group concepts and quantum channel capacity analysis into the study of thermodynamic dissipation, establishing more rigorous connections between predictive state representations and information-theoretic entropy bounds in nonequilibrium engines.

detail.title: Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds in Nonequilibrium Systems
detail.summary: This notebook synthesizes new evidence on renormalization group applications and quantum communication channels with memory to update the bounds on dissipation in predictive systems. It finds that dissipation is constrained by the separable-state capacity of memory channels and that renormalization provides a framework for multi-scale entropy production.
detail.reason: Incorporating new theoretical evidence regarding renormalization group mechanics and quantum memory channels into the predictive-dissipation framework.
